descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Real boxing fitness requires proper mechanics. Boxing Drills VR focuses entirely on practical padwork and drills. Your virtual coach handles the combinations. You move, punch, and slip just like in a real gym. 

We built this to help you practice footwork, guard discipline, and hip rotation. If you punch too softly, it does not register. If you drop your guard, you lose points. Stand flat-footed, and the trainer steps out of range.

**Train with real standards**
* Practice combos, defense, and footwork drills. 
* The pad trainer moves, forcing you to reposition.
* A velocity threshold makes you commit to your shots.
* Scoring tracks your core rotation, not just quick hands.
* Real-time feedback on punch speed, power, and form.
* Play in orthodox or southpaw stance.
* Workout mode is exceptional for fitness and burning calories


**Track your progress**

The app scores your power, speed, agility, and form to show how your mechanics improve. 

Whether you use this to warm up for a sparring simulator or as your main cardio routine, the pads are ready when you are. 

Join the Discord at https://discord.gg/8FyagxceKs to help shape what comes next, we are frequently adding new updates.

**Clear some space, put the headset on, and try your first drill today.***
